rationale.overall: The two takes are identical in subject, staging, glow and lighting; the only real difference is the ground texture, and A's finer, lower-relief grain sits closer to the REFERENCE's soft matte surface while B's coarse embossing competes with the subject.
rationale.material: REFERENCE shows a fine, dense, low-amplitude striated concrete grain that reads as surface quality rather than pattern — A reproduces that scale and subtlety, whereas B's chunky raised crosshatch ridges read as embossed vinyl/leather and overstate the relief relative to the reference.
rationale.silhouette: The block, its chamfers, the paper loop and the red under-glow are pixel-for-pixel the same in both takes, so neither has an edge on shape read.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16px the two strips are effectively indistinguishable — the dark bar, warm rim line and loop resolve identically and the background grain difference disappears below the pixel grid.
